name: apply_format_settings_sequence
description: Makes a fixed sequence of calls through a library base pointer stored in a global variable, passing two constants first, then a flag, then the argument and the result of an inner routine.

name: invoke_global_and_measure_string
description: Calls a function pointer held in a global variable, then counts the length of a 140-byte stack buffer up to its null terminator. If the buffer is non-empty it passes the buffer and its length to another routine.

name: store_low_byte_at_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the data register to the memory address held in the address register and returns. It has no other logic.

name: divide_long_with_remainder
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a divisor and returns quotient and remainder. For divisors above 16 bits it runs a 16-step shift-and-subtract loop, otherwise it performs two 16-bit divisions.

name: shift_subtract_divide_loop
description: Runs the 16-step shift-and-subtract division loop on a 32-bit dividend and a divisor held in registers, leaving quotient bits in the low half of the working register and the remainder in the high half.

name: multiply_32_bit_integers
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values using 16-bit partial products. The product fills the high long of the result, and the second operand with its halves swapped fills the low long.

name: invoke_table_entry
description: Calls the function whose address is stored at a fixed offset inside a global data block and returns with no result of its own.

name: store_byte_via_address_register
description: Stores the low byte of the data register at the address in the address register, then returns.

name: allocate_and_initialize_block
description: Allocates a memory block through a library call, fills its pointer, flag and count fields from the arguments, then either sets up a list head or passes the block to another routine. It returns the block address or zero.

name: reset_object_and_recurse
description: Recursively processes the linked block when its pointer field is set, then marks the byte and long fields as all ones, calls a routine with the stored byte value and calls another routine with the block and a constant.

name: forward_argument_with_constant
description: Passes its single argument to another routine together with the constant 48 and returns nothing.

name: forward_single_argument
description: Passes its single argument unchanged to another routine and returns nothing.

name: setup_trashcan_with_requesters_disabled
description: Clears the process window pointer while it sets up global fields that reference the Trashcan text, runs initial routines and then restores the window pointer. It returns a 16-bit status value.

name: read_signed_byte_result
description: Reads one byte through a routine that takes a global argument and a stack buffer. It returns the byte sign-extended on success and minus one otherwise.

name: invoke_library_entry_240
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset from a global library base, passing no arguments and returning no value in the shown code.

name: setup_pointer_chain
description: Writes the block's own address plus four into its first long word, clears the second long word and stores the block's original address in the third.

name: store_word_pointer_in_node
description: Allocates a node through a library-backed routine when the pointer argument is non-null, then stores the value 5 as a byte, the argument word and the pointer into fixed fields. It returns the node or zero.

name: reset_node_and_release_it
description: Returns zero for a null pointer. Otherwise it marks the node byte and two long fields as all ones, then passes the node and its stored word to another routine and returns that result.

name: invoke_library_entry_90

name: invoke_library_entry_78

name: invoke_supervisor_function

name: invoke_exit_interrupt_function

name: invoke_dispatch_function

name: invoke_alloc_entry_function

name: open_new_cli_session

name: free_linked_node_list

name: iterate_table_with_function
description: Calls another routine four times, each time with a field from a structure and one entry of a four-entry global array, then returns.

name: validate_input_buffer
description: Prepares an 80-byte buffer through two routine calls, then scans its bytes and stops at the first byte outside the permitted value ranges.

name: read_pager_key_command
description: Waits for input in a loop that also checks a signal mask, then maps the key code to a pager command value. Some keys are ignored when flags are set in the state structure.

name: invoke_editor_from_environment
description: Calls a routine with a global text argument, then invokes a stored function pointer. The text references include the ENV:EDITOR variable and a reopen failure message.

name: initialize_pager_state
description: Sets the pager state fields, runs a routine on the structure and stores its result, then conditionally calls further routines based on structure fields.

name: update_page_counter_after_scan
description: Calls two routines with arguments derived from the structure, stores the second result in a field, and increments a short counter in a nested block when a flag field is zero.

name: parse_buffer_content
description: Reads up to 128 bytes into a buffer and scans for a newline or form-feed character, stopping there. A form-feed is rewritten as a two-character marker followed by a newline, and the byte count is returned.

name: show_page_lines_until_quit
description: Computes the number of lines for the page from structure fields, prints table entries while the position is below the limit, reads a key and stops when the q key or Ctrl-C is pressed.

name: handle_search_loop
description: Uses a flag in the argument block to choose a global variable, repeatedly calls a search routine while showing the searching message, and increments a counter until a result is found. The text references include the searching message.

name: initialize_handler
description: Runs a sequence of calls to another routine using arguments from a parameter block and a global variable, optionally repeating one call, and returns the result of one of those calls.

name: check_flag_and_call
description: Calls another routine with two arguments, then calls it again with the first argument alone when a short flag field in the structure is zero.

name: update_window_bounds_calls
description: Calls a routine with two fields from the structure and a fixed argument, then calls another routine with a value read from a nested structure.

name: update_text_window_range
description: Calls a routine with a field, zero and one, then calls another routine with a value taken from a nested structure minus one.

name: scroll_text_buffer_lines
description: Reads up to 128-byte blocks from a text buffer and calls routines for each line, counting lines until the requested number is reached or a flag stops the loop. The listing is truncated, so the final steps are not certain.

name: dispatch_with_structure_pointer
description: Calls a routine with a structure pointer, then calls another routine with a pointer read from that structure, a global variable and the first argument.

name: set_flag_and_forward
description: When a field is zero it sets a short counter in a nested structure to one, then calls another routine with global values. It returns nothing.

name: dispatch_by_flag
description: Selects two pointers according to a flag in the parameter block, using globals or a table entry, and calls another routine with them.

name: dispatch_handler_by_flag
description: Reads a flag from the parameter block and calls another routine with either three global references or a value from a table entry.

name: clamp_negative_result
description: Calls another routine twice with the same first argument and different third arguments, then clamps a negative return value to zero before returning it.

name: copy_buffer_chunk_and_advance
description: Limits a requested count to the remaining size in a structure, copies that many bytes from the buffer at the current offset into the destination, then advances the offset by the copied count. It refills the buffer first when more data is needed.

name: refill_buffer_from_source
description: Reads the next block into the buffer at the current offset when data remains and a state field holds the expected mode, otherwise returns zero. It also schedules other work through a library call.

name: validate_scroll_position
description: Checks a requested position against the window bounds and updates the window fields, returning a status value. A negative position returns minus one.

name: read_line_from_buffer
description: Reads bytes one at a time into the destination, stopping after a newline or a fixed limit of about 127 bytes, then appends a null terminator.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from the source string to the destination until and including the null terminator.

name: convert_string_to_uppercase
description: Walks a null-terminated string and converts lowercase ASCII letters to uppercase by subtracting 32, leaving other bytes unchanged.

name: parse_signed_decimal_string
description: Parses an optional leading plus or minus sign followed by decimal digits from a null-terminated string and returns the signed value. Parsing stops at the first character that is not a digit.

name: call_library_function_with_mask
description: When the first argument and a structure pointer are both non-null, calls a library function through a stored base with the argument and a full mask. Otherwise it returns without action.

name: process_pager_structure_fields
description: Calls routines on the pointer fields of a structure when they are non-null, then calls library functions for interrupt control. The listing is only partly shown.

name: write_single_value_via_handle
description: Writes its argument as a single item through a handle obtained from a routine, passing a constant and a one-item stack buffer, and returns the result.

name: allocate_and_fill_info_block
description: Allocates a 36-byte block through a routine and returns zero if that fails. Otherwise it queries a handle, fills the block from the result and copies two fields into the structure.

name: initialize_object_from_template
description: Obtains a template identifier and allocates an object when the argument is non-null, then links its fields to the template and source block and copies words from the source address into it. Returns zero on failure.

name: invoke_reschedule_function
description: Calls the exec Reschedule function through a stored library base.

name: invoke_task_switch_function
description: Calls the exec Switch function through a stored library base to hand control to another task.

name: invoke_dispatch_function
description: Calls the exec Dispatch function through a stored library base.

name: invoke_alloc_mem_function
description: Calls the exec AllocMem function through a stored library base, with no arguments set in the shown code.

name: invoke_library_entry_132
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset from a global library base, with no arguments and no result handling in the shown code.
